title: Page masthead

fields.label: Label above the title
fields.name: page_eyebrow
fields.instructions: Optional. Two or three words, e.g. “Our work” or “Get involved”.

fields.label: Sentence below the title
fields.name: page_lead
fields.instructions: Optional. One or two sentences. This is also what search engines and social networks show if no SEO description is set.

fields.label: The photograph
fields.name: masthead_note
fields.message: Set the page’s Featured image to put a photograph behind the title. Without one the band is flat deep blue, which is a supported look rather than a fallback. Landscape, at least 1920px across.

description: The band at the top of the page. The title and the photograph come from the page itself — these two fields are the label above the title and the sentence below it.
